title: Quality issue B10
text: B10 (Validity, severity Medium): Incorrect storage types (integers stored as floats, dates stored as text) Affected records: 25907 of 25907 (100.0%) in table results, columns season, round, number, date Evidence: season/round/number inferred as float64 because of missing values; date is an untyped string Likely cause: JSON nulls force numeric columns to float when loaded; no schema was enforced at ingestion. title: Quality issue B11
text: B11 (Validity, severity High): 'position' is filled for drivers who were not classified Affected records: 9646 of 25907 (37.233%) in table results, columns position, positionText Evidence: positionText codes R/W/D: {'R': 9129, 'W': 358, 'D': 159} all carry a numeric 'position' Likely cause: Source semantics: 'position' is the order of finishing incl. retirements, not the official result. Impact if not fixed: Analyses that treat 'position' as the result (e.g. grid-vs-finish regressions, the project dashboard) count a retirement as e.g. 18th place, biasing targets for prediction models. Resolution: Fixed (classified_position separated from position_order) (cleaning step C06; affected records before cleaning 9646, after 0)

title: Quality issue B12
text: B12 (Consistency, severity Medium): Non-standard categorical values: free-text status Affected records: 25907 of 25907 (100.0%) in table results, columns status Evidence: 136 distinct values; 122 values each <1% of rows; mixes finishing margin ('+1 Lap' to '+46 Laps', 'Lapped') with causes ('Engine', 'Accident') Likely cause: Status is recorded verbatim from race reports over 75 years without a controlled vocabulary. Impact if not fixed: One-hot encoding creates 136 sparse features; reliability analyses (DNF causes) cannot be aggregated. Resolution: Fixed (136 values -> 8 controlled groups; raw kept) (cleaning step C07; affected records before cleaning 25907, after 0)

title: Quality issue B13

title: Quality issue B14

title: Quality issue B15
text: B15 (Consistency, severity Medium): Points not comparable across eras (scoring rules changed) Affected records: 8425 of 25907 (32.52%) in table results, columns points Evidence: points for a win range 4-50; the typical winner score changes in 7 seasons (1950: 9, 1951: 8, 1952: 9, 1953: 8, 1961: 9, 1991: 10, 2010: 25); 10 fractional values (shared drives / shared fastest lap, e.g. 8.14, 1.33) Likely cause: Not a recording error: FIA scoring systems changed (1950, 1960, 1961, 1991, 2003, 2010, 2014 double points, 2019 fastest lap). Resolution: Mitigated (points_normalised added) (cleaning step C09; affected records before cleaning 8425, after nan)

title: component_a_summary: Licence findings
text: Jolpica-F1 Terms of Use (TERMS.md, updated 27 Aug 2025, https://github.com/jolpica/jolpica-f1/blob/main/TERMS.md): data licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial use; the code repository itself is Apache-2.0. Ergast Developer API terms (Wayback snapshot 18 May 2024 of https://ergast.com/mrd/terms/, live page now 404): "You may use this API for personal, non-commercial applications and services including educational and research purposes"; attribution appreciated, not required. Kaggle mirror (rohanrao/formula-1-world-championship-1950-2020, version 24, updated 29 Jan 2025): declared "CC0: Public Domain", although compiled from Ergast, whose terms were non-commercial - a licence inconsistency. Group repository README: "MIT License" for the whole project, no data licence - conflicts with CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Zenodo record of the raw archive (10.5281/zenodo.23416916): declares CC BY 4.0, which drops the non-commercial and share-alike conditions of the source - to be corrected to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (a metadata edit; the DOI does not change). F-UJI scores the licence as present, not as compliant. Decision: curated data released under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 (ShareAlike obligation); MIT kept for code only.

title: fair_gaps: G1 - No persistent identifier for the data or metadata
text: **RDA indicators:** RDA-F1-01D; RDA-F1-01M; RDA-F3-01M; RDA-A1-03D **Evidence:** F-UJI FsF-F1-02MD = 0 for the GitHub archive, the Jolpica API and even the Kaggle mirror; data are only reachable by mutable URLs. The group's Zenodo deposit of the raw archive (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23416916, 16 Oct 2026) scores 1 and lifts the archive to 84.6% overall (F-UJI v0.8). **Improvement:** Use the Zenodo DOI as the identifier of the source archive (cited IsDerivedFrom and in PROV-O), and deposit the curated package as its own Zenodo record to mint a versioned DOI and a concept DOI; cite both in README and CITATION.cff. **Status in delivered package:** Raw archive: implemented (DOI minted by the group, byte-identical to data/source). Curated package: prepared (DataCite record cites the raw DOI; own DOI placeholder).

title: fair_gaps: G2 - Missing and conflicting licence information
text: **RDA indicators:** RDA-R1.1-01M; RDA-R1.1-02M; RDA-R1.1-03M **Evidence:** Jolpica TERMS.md (27 Aug 2025): data licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The group's README declares 'MIT License' for everything; the Kaggle mirror declares CC0 although Ergast allowed non-commercial use only; the group's Zenodo record declares CC BY 4.0, which drops the non-commercial and share-alike conditions. F-UJI FsF-R1.1-01M = 0 for GitHub and Jolpica and 1 for Kaggle and Zenodo, because it checks that a licence is present, not that it is compatible. **Improvement:** License the data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (ShareAlike obliges it), add LICENSE-DATA with the SPDX id CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 and the legal-code URI, keep MIT for code only, and attribute Jolpica-F1 and Ergast. **Status in delivered package:** Implemented in DataCite rightsList, schema.org license and datapackage.json; the Zenodo record's licence must be corrected to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (a metadata edit, the DOI does not change).

title: fair_gaps: G3 - No machine-readable, standard dataset metadata
text: **RDA indicators:** RDA-F2-01M; RDA-F4-01M; RDA-I1-01M; RDA-R1-01M; RDA-R1.3-01M; RDA-R1.3-02M **Evidence:** Only a pipeline README; F-UJI FsF-F2-01M = 0/2 (GitHub, Jolpica); FsF-R1-01M = 1/2 (GitHub) and 0/2 (Jolpica). **Improvement:** Ship a DataCite 4.5 record (XML validated against the XSD), schema.org Dataset JSON-LD for search engines and a Frictionless Data Package with a full data dictionary. **Status in delivered package:** Implemented.

title: fair_gaps: G4 - Non-standard vocabularies inside the data
text: **RDA indicators:** RDA-I2-01D; RDA-I1-02D **Evidence:** Country values 'UK', 'USA', 'UAE', 'Korea'; nationalities as lowercase demonyms including former states ('east german', 'rhodesian'); 136 free-text status values mixing laps-behind with failure causes. **Improvement:** Add ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes (ISO 3166-3 for former states), Wikidata QIDs, and an 8-category status vocabulary; publish the status vocabulary as SKOS. **Status in delivered package:** ISO codes, QIDs and status groups implemented; SKOS publication proposed.

title: fair_gaps: G5 - No provenance or integrity information
text: **RDA indicators:** RDA-R1.2-01M; RDA-R1.2-02M **Evidence:** The repository never names Ergast or Jolpica as the source; no checksums; no record of transformations; the original Ergast terms page now returns 404. **Improvement:** Record derivation (DataCite IsDerivedFrom), SHA-256 checksums of every source and output file, the cleaning audit log, and a W3C PROV-O graph. **Status in delivered package:** Implemented.

title: fair_gaps: G6 - Unqualified and partly broken links to external entities
text: **RDA indicators:** RDA-I3-01D; RDA-I3-02D **Evidence:** 861 of 864 driver URLs use http; 12 entities have no URL; 1 driver URL is a Wikipedia talk page (monarch); 2 constructor pages no longer exist (Hall, Turner). **Improvement:** Normalise to https and add Wikidata QIDs as persistent entity identifiers; flag unresolved links for manual curation. **Status in delivered package:** Implemented (QID crosswalk in data/reference/).

title: fair_gaps: G7 - No guarantee that metadata outlives the data
text: **RDA indicators:** RDA-A2-01M **Evidence:** The Ergast API was shut down and is only mirrored by a volunteer project (Jolpica) that 'does not guarantee uptime'; GitHub repositories can be deleted. **Improvement:** Deposit in a certified repository (Zenodo/CERN) whose policy keeps metadata and a tombstone page after withdrawal. **Status in delivered package:** Raw archive deposited in Zenodo by the group (16 Oct 2026); deposit of the curated package proposed.

title: quality_issues: B01 - Season missing
text: **Dimension:** Completeness ; **Table/columns:** results / season **Affected:** 5 of 25907 (0.019%) ; **Severity:** High ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** results_1960.json lines 193, 196-199 **Root-cause hypothesis:** Field dropped while copying a block of rows (all affected rows belong to one race block). **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Rows cannot be joined to races/circuits and silently vanish from per-season aggregates and model training sets. **Resolved by:** C02

title: quality_issues: B02 - Round missing
text: **Dimension:** Completeness ; **Table/columns:** results / round **Affected:** 7 of 25907 (0.027%) ; **Severity:** High ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** results_1960.json lines 193-195, 200-203 **Root-cause hypothesis:** Same corrupted block as B01 (1960 Italian GP). **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Race-level features (circuit, date) cannot be attached; orphaned facts in a star schema. **Resolved by:** C02

title: quality_issues: B03 - Car number missing
text: **Dimension:** Completeness ; **Table/columns:** results / number **Affected:** 6 of 25907 (0.023%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** False **Evidence:** all 6 rows have positionText 'W' (withdrawn entries): {'W': 6} **Root-cause hypothesis:** Structurally missing (not applicable): a withdrawn entry was never assigned a race number. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** None if handled as nullable; imputing a number would invent facts. **Resolved by:** C01

title: quality_issues: B04 - Disguised missing value: grid = 0 sentinel
text: **Dimension:** Completeness ; **Table/columns:** results / grid **Affected:** 267 of 25907 (1.031%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** 0 is not a grid slot; status of these rows: {'Withdrew': 164, 'Accident': 19, '+1 Lap': 18, 'Finished': 11} **Root-cause hypothesis:** Source encodes 'pit-lane start / no grid slot' as 0 instead of null. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Grid-vs-result models treat 0 as pole-better-than-pole; mean grid is biased low; correlation with finishing position is distorted. **Resolved by:** C05

title: quality_issues: B05 - Races with fewer entries than the season norm (2014+): verified, not data loss
text: **Dimension:** Completeness ; **Table/columns:** results / (record level) **Affected:** 7 of 252 (2.778%) ; **Severity:** Info ; **Error:** False **Evidence:** 2014 R16: 21/22 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['jules_bianchi'] ; 2014 R17: 18/22 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['chilton', 'ericsson', 'kobayashi'] ; 2014 R18: 18/22 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['kobayashi', 'stevens'] ; 2014 R19: 20/22 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: [] ; 2015 R1: 18/20 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['alonso', 'merhi', 'stevens'] ; 2024 R3: 19/20 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['bearman', 'sargeant'] ; 2025 R9: 19/20 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['stroll'] **Root-cause hypothesis:** Each gap matches a documented real-world absence (e.g. Marussia/Caterham missing late 2014, Stroll injured for the 2025 Spanish GP), not a lost record. Should still be confirmed against the official FIA classification before publication. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** None if verified; shows why record-count anomaly detection needs domain verification before imputation. **Resolved by:** None (verified as genuine)

title: quality_issues: B06 - Exact duplicate records
text: **Dimension:** Uniqueness ; **Table/columns:** results / all **Affected:** 23 of 25907 (0.089%) ; **Severity:** High ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** duplicated copies at results_1960.json lines 227-249 **Root-cause hypothesis:** A block of rows was appended twice (copy/paste or a re-run of an append-only load). **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Double-counts points and wins, inflates sample weight of one race, leaks identical rows across train/test splits. **Resolved by:** C03

title: quality_issues: B07 - Hidden duplicates masked by missing keys
text: **Dimension:** Uniqueness ; **Table/columns:** results / all **Affected:** 11 of 25907 (0.042%) ; **Severity:** High ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** rows results_1960.json lines 193-203 become exact copies of complete rows once season/round are restored **Root-cause hypothesis:** The duplicated block of B06 was additionally damaged (keys blanked), so naive exact-match de-duplication misses it. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Same as B06; also shows that cleaning order matters (repair keys before de-duplicating). **Resolved by:** C02 + C03

title: quality_issues: B08 - Natural-key collisions that are NOT errors (shared drives)
text: **Dimension:** Uniqueness ; **Table/columns:** results / season, round, driverId **Affected:** 172 of 25907 (0.664%) ; **Severity:** Info ; **Error:** False **Evidence:** 83 driver-race groups; car number differs in 83/83; seasons 1950-1964 **Root-cause hypothesis:** Historic rule allowed a driver to take over a team-mate's car; each car is a separate classified entry. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Naive de-duplication on (season, round, driver) would delete real history; the correct key includes the car number. **Resolved by:** C11 (flag is_shared_drive)

title: quality_issues: B09 - Identifier violates lowercase convention
text: **Dimension:** Validity ; **Table/columns:** results / driverId **Affected:** 2 of 25907 (0.008%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** values ['Cannoc', 'scott_Brown'] at results_1956.json line 134; results_1971.json line 242 **Root-cause hypothesis:** Manual edit of identifiers (mixed case) in the source. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Case-sensitive joins with other F1 sources fail; the same driver can appear as two entities. **Resolved by:** C04

title: quality_issues: B10 - Incorrect storage types (integers stored as floats, dates stored as text)
text: **Dimension:** Validity ; **Table/columns:** results / season, round, number, date **Affected:** 25907 of 25907 (100.0%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** season/round/number inferred as float64 because of missing values; date is an untyped string **Root-cause hypothesis:** JSON nulls force numeric columns to float when loaded; no schema was enforced at ingestion. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Keys like 1960.0 break joins and string IDs; dates cannot be used for time-based splits without parsing. **Resolved by:** C01

title: quality_issues: B11 - 'position' is filled for drivers who were not classified
text: **Dimension:** Validity ; **Table/columns:** results / position, positionText **Affected:** 9646 of 25907 (37.233%) ; **Severity:** High ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** positionText codes R/W/D: {'R': 9129, 'W': 358, 'D': 159} all carry a numeric 'position' **Root-cause hypothesis:** Source semantics: 'position' is the order of finishing incl. retirements, not the official result. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Analyses that treat 'position' as the result (e.g. grid-vs-finish regressions, the project dashboard) count a retirement as e.g. 18th place, biasing targets for prediction models. **Resolved by:** C06

title: quality_issues: B12 - Non-standard categorical values: free-text status
text: **Dimension:** Consistency ; **Table/columns:** results / status **Affected:** 25907 of 25907 (100.0%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** 136 distinct values; 122 values each <1% of rows; mixes finishing margin ('+1 Lap' to '+46 Laps', 'Lapped') with causes ('Engine', 'Accident') **Root-cause hypothesis:** Status is recorded verbatim from race reports over 75 years without a controlled vocabulary. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** One-hot encoding creates 136 sparse features; reliability analyses (DNF causes) cannot be aggregated. **Resolved by:** C07

title: quality_issues: B13 - Contradiction: retired ('R') but status says lapped finish
text: **Dimension:** Consistency ; **Table/columns:** results / positionText, status **Affected:** 26 of 25907 (0.1%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** seasons [1956, 1967, 1978, 1979, 1980, 2005, 2006, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2014] **Root-cause hypothesis:** Driver was running at the flag but covered <90% distance (not classified); status and code disagree. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** DNF-rate features are inconsistent depending on which field is used. **Resolved by:** C06 (flag status_position_conflict)

title: quality_issues: B14 - Inconsistent text formatting (proper names stored in lowercase)
text: **Dimension:** Consistency ; **Table/columns:** results / raceName **Affected:** 25907 of 25907 (100.0%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** raceName, circuitName, locality and driver names are lowercase while constructor names keep proper case **Root-cause hypothesis:** A normalisation step lowercased some tables during an earlier export. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Cosmetic for models but reduces readability, breaks exact matching with external sources (e.g. Wikidata labels). **Resolved by:** C10, C11

title: quality_issues: B15 - Points not comparable across eras (scoring rules changed)
text: **Dimension:** Consistency ; **Table/columns:** results / points **Affected:** 8425 of 25907 (32.52%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** points for a win range 4-50; the typical winner score changes in 7 seasons (1950: 9, 1951: 8, 1952: 9, 1953: 8, 1961: 9, 1991: 10, 2010: 25); 10 fractional values (shared drives / shared fastest lap, e.g. 8.14, 1.33) **Root-cause hypothesis:** Not a recording error: FIA scoring systems changed (1950, 1960, 1961, 1991, 2003, 2010, 2014 double points, 2019 fastest lap). **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** All-time rankings and models using raw points are dominated by the post-2010 era (25 points per win). **Resolved by:** C09

title: quality_issues: B16 - Statistical outliers that are valid (Indianapolis 500)
text: **Dimension:** Accuracy ; **Table/columns:** results / laps **Affected:** 270 of 25907 (1.042%) ; **Severity:** Info ; **Error:** False **Evidence:** IQR upper fence 122.5 laps; flagged rows by race: {'indianapolis 500': 270} **Root-cause hypothesis:** Indy 500 (200 laps, 1950-1960) counted for the championship under different rules. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Removing them as 'outliers' would delete valid history; keeping them unflagged skews lap-based features. **Resolved by:** C08

title: quality_issues: B17 - Results that cannot be linked to a race
text: **Dimension:** Referential integrity ; **Table/columns:** results / season, round **Affected:** 11 of 25907 (0.042%) ; **Severity:** High ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** results_1960.json lines 193-203 **Root-cause hypothesis:** Consequence of B01/B02. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Inner joins drop these rows silently; left joins create rows without circuit/date. **Resolved by:** C02

title: quality_issues: B18 - Duplicate race records
text: **Dimension:** Uniqueness ; **Table/columns:** races / all **Affected:** 5 of 1178 (0.424%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** duplicated (season, round): ['2008-R12', '1950-R4', '1991-R15', '1982-R9', '2025-R12'] **Root-cause hypothesis:** Rows appended twice at the end of the file (rows 1174-1178). **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Join fan-out: every result of these races is duplicated after a join with races. **Resolved by:** C10

title: quality_issues: B19 - Duplicate circuits (exact copies and copies without ID)
text: **Dimension:** Uniqueness ; **Table/columns:** circuits / circuitId, url **Affected:** 4 of 82 (4.878%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** exact copies: ['dijon', 'indianapolis']; ID missing but same url as existing circuit: ['circuit gilles villeneuve', 'losail international circuit'] **Root-cause hypothesis:** Circuits re-added during a merge without their key. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Join fan-out on circuitId; a map aggregates the same circuit twice. **Resolved by:** C10

title: quality_issues: B20 - Same person under two identifiers
text: **Dimension:** Uniqueness ; **Table/columns:** drivers / driverId **Affected:** 2 of 874 (0.229%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** [{'driverId': 'arvid_lindblad', 'dateOfBirth': nan}, {'driverId': 'lindblad', 'dateOfBirth': '2007-08-08'}] **Root-cause hypothesis:** A new driver was added twice by two ingestion runs with different ID conventions. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Entity resolution error: career statistics split across two nodes in the graph. **Resolved by:** C10

title: quality_issues: B21 - Country names not in a standard vocabulary
text: **Dimension:** Validity ; **Table/columns:** circuits / country **Affected:** 19 of 82 (23.171%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** {'USA': 13, 'UK': 4, 'UAE': 1, 'Korea': 1} (ambiguous: 'Korea'); nationalities are free-text demonyms incl. former states ('east german', 'rhodesian') **Root-cause hypothesis:** Abbreviations typed by hand; no ISO 3166 codes in the source. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Geo joins and choropleth maps fail (the dashboard map showed only 1 country); no interoperability. **Resolved by:** C10

title: quality_issues: B22 - Missing coordinates
text: **Dimension:** Completeness ; **Table/columns:** circuits / lat, long **Affected:** 1 of 82 (1.22%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** ['madring'] **Root-cause hypothesis:** New 2026 venue added before its coordinates were published. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Circuit cannot be placed on a map or used in distance features. **Resolved by:** Documented (kept missing)

title: quality_issues: B23 - Missing attributes for newest entities
text: **Dimension:** Completeness ; **Table/columns:** drivers / constructors / dateOfBirth, nationality, url **Affected:** 12 of 1088 (1.103%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** drivers: ['paul_aron', 'luke_browning', 'jak_crawford', 'ryo_hirakawa', 'ayumu_iwasa', 'arthur_leclerc', 'arvid_lindblad', 'lindblad', 'patricio_o_ward', 'cian_shields']; constructors: ['audi', 'cadillac'] **Root-cause hypothesis:** Timeliness: 2026 entrants/reserves were added before their profiles existed upstream. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Age and nationality features are missing for recent drivers (none of them has a race result yet). **Resolved by:** Documented (kept missing)

title: quality_issues: B24 - Reference calendar ahead of the results snapshot
text: **Dimension:** Timeliness ; **Table/columns:** races / season **Affected:** 24 of 1178 (2.037%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** False **Evidence:** 24 races of season 2026 without results; latest date 2026-12-06 **Root-cause hypothesis:** Calendar for the upcoming season is published before results exist; tables were exported at different times. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Counting races per season or per circuit over-states 2026; an inner join hides the mismatch. **Resolved by:** C10 (flag has_results)

title: quality_issues: B25 - Mixed URL schemes (http vs https)
text: **Dimension:** Consistency ; **Table/columns:** drivers / constructors / url **Affected:** 1073 of 2336 (45.933%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** {'https': 1263, 'http': 1073} across all reference tables **Root-cause hypothesis:** Links copied from different Wikipedia snapshots. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Exact-match linking (e.g. to Wikidata) misses entities; mixed-content warnings in web apps. **Resolved by:** C10

title: quality_issues: B26 - Proper names stored in lowercase
text: **Dimension:** Consistency ; **Table/columns:** drivers / circuits / name, circuitName, locality **Affected:** 956 of 956 (100.0%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** e.g. 'carlo abate', 'circuit gilles villeneuve', 'montreal'; constructors use proper case ('McLaren') **Root-cause hypothesis:** Same lowercasing step as B14. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Readability and matching with external authority files. **Resolved by:** C10

title: quality_issues: B27 - Name differs from the official spelling
text: **Dimension:** Accuracy ; **Table/columns:** circuits / circuitName **Affected:** 2 of 82 (2.439%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** 'losail international circuit' while the Wikipedia/official name is 'Lusail International Circuit' **Root-cause hypothesis:** Legacy transliteration kept from an older source. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Text matching against official sources fails. **Resolved by:** Documented (kept, alias noted)

title: quality_issues: B28 - Mixed file formats in one package
text: **Dimension:** Consistency ; **Table/columns:** source package / file format **Affected:** 8 of 93 (8.602%) ; **Severity:** Low ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** 5 sprint files are pretty-printed JSON arrays while all other JSON files are JSON Lines; 3 non-data files (.DS_Store, empty .flag markers) **Root-cause hypothesis:** Files produced by different scripts; macOS metadata zipped by accident. **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Generic loaders fail on part of the package; reproducibility depends on undocumented conventions. **Resolved by:** Step 0 (format detection in manifest)

title: quality_issues: B29 - Retirement causes no longer recorded in recent seasons
text: **Dimension:** Consistency ; **Table/columns:** results / status **Affected:** 129 of 25907 (0.498%) ; **Severity:** Medium ; **Error:** True **Evidence:** share of retirements stored only as 'Retired': 2019: 2%, 2020: 2%, 2021: 2%, 2022: 0%, 2023: 89%, 2024: 100%, 2025: 100% (found when the reliability trend was visualised in the project dashboard) **Root-cause hypothesis:** Recording practice changed in the source from 2023: retirements are entered with the generic status 'Retired' instead of the cause (engine, accident, ...). **Downstream impact (DS/AI):** Reliability trends and failure-cause models see a false collapse of mechanical failures and accidents after 2022; models trained across this boundary learn a spurious time effect. **Resolved by:** C07 (mapped to 'Retired (unspecified)'; cause analyses limited to earlier seasons)

title: README: Run it
text: Requirements: Python 3.11 or newer and the packages in `requirements.txt`. No network access is needed once the packages are installed. LibreOffice is only needed to turn the Word report and the slides into PDF (macOS: `brew install --cask libreoffice`); without it the `.docx` and `.pptx` are still written. macOS / Linux: ```bash cd data_management_project python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt python run_all.py --from-scratch # rebuild every dataset, table and figure (~90 s) python -m pytest -q # 28 tests: cleaning decisions and the assistant python -m src.build_report # joint report (Word + PDF) python -m src.build_slides # presentation deck (PowerPoint + PDF) and presenter script python build_submission.py # group ZIP for the course portal -> dist/ ``` Windows (PowerShell): the same commands, with `py -3.11 -m venv .venv` and `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`. Everything the pipeline produces is already committed, so the report (`report/`), the slides (`report/presentation/`), the submission ZIP (`dist/`) and the dashboard open without running anything. The slides use the dashboard's fonts (Titillium Web, Source Serif 4; OFL licence, in `report/assets/fonts/`): present from the PDF, which embeds them, or install the fonts before opening or rebuilding the PowerPoint. A run from scratch must print these hashes for the cleaned files (the CSVs are stored byte-for-byte, see `.gitattributes`): `

title: README: Interactive dashboard
text: The final stage of the pipeline. `run_all.py` writes `../dashboard/static/data.js` from the validated outputs; open the dashboard with `cd ../dashboard` and `streamlit run app.py` (http://localhost:8501), or open `../dashboard/static/index.html` directly in a browser. Seven views: constructor eras, all-time timing tower, grid to finish, reliability, circuits globe, team-mate network and the data-quality story. Building it revealed issue B29 (retirement causes not recorded from 2023). The earlier multi-page dashboard built on the Spark gold layer (sections RQ1-RQ6) is kept unchanged as `../dashboard/app_classic.py` (`streamlit run app_classic.py`).

title: README: Ask-the-data assistant
text: The served zone also answers questions in English or Spanish ("How many Grands Prix has Lewis Hamilton won?", "¿Quién ganó el campeonato de 1988?"). It rebuilds Manohar Zalki's Graphic-LlmRag prototype (FastAPI + Ollama Llama 3 + hybrid vector/graph retrieval + ML engine) on the validated data: 1. **Understand**: drivers, teams, circuits, Grands Prix and seasons are found in the question. 2. **Evidence**: exact figures computed with pandas from `data/cleaned/` (with file, SHA-256, filter, rows and raw `source_file:source_line`), team-mate chains from the graph, the podium model, and the best of 1,324 knowledge documents (BM25 keywords, plus semantic vectors when computed). 3. **Write**: the local Llama 3 answers from that evidence only and cites it ([S1], [S2]). 4. **Check**: every number in the answer is looked up in the evidence; untraceable figures are flagged. World Champions come from Wikidata and are reconciled with our points (1964 and 1988 differ because of the dropped-scores rule). The podium model uses only pre-race information and a time-based split (train 1950-2013, choose on 2014-2019, test once on 2020-2025); its scores are computed, see `outputs/assistant/podium_model_card.json`. Benchmark: `python -m src.assistant.evaluate [--llm]`. ```bash

title: README: optional, for written answers: install Ollama (https://ollama.com), then
text: ollama pull llama3 && ollama pull nomic-embed-text python -m src.assistant.api # http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs (the dashboard starts it itself) python -m src.assistant.knowledge --embed # optional: semantic vectors for the documents ``` Without Ollama the assistant still returns the evidence. On a laptop CPU the written answer takes 15-60 s; with a GPU (Apple Silicon, NVIDIA) a few seconds. `F1_ASSISTANT_MODEL=llama3.2:3b` selects a lighter model. The `/chat` endpoint keeps the prototype's contract, so `../dashboard/app_classic.py` (page RQ6) works on top of the same engine.

title: README: Data flow
text: ``` data/source/racing_f1_data.zip original package (SHA-256 81b027c4...c748), never modified > data/raw/*.csv flattened, values unchanged, + source_file/source_line lineage > outputs/component_b_quality/ 29-issue register, profiles, passed checks, figures > data/cleaned/*.csv 25,873 results x 35 columns + 4 reference tables > outputs/component_c_cleaning/ audit log, 55 validation gates, issue resolution > outputs/graph/ property graph + team-mate network (GEXF for Gephi), metrics > outputs/component_a_fair/ F-UJI evidence, RDA scores, DataCite 4.5, schema.org, PROV-O > ../dashboard/static/data.js interactive dashboard (served zone) > outputs/assistant/ podium model card, knowledge documents, benchmark (served zone API) ```

title: README: Before submission (group to complete)
text: 1. Add ORCID iDs in `src/config.py` (`TEAM`), and confirm who presents each block, then re-run `python run_all.py`, `python -m src.build_report` and `python -m src.build_slides`. 2. Confirm the institution ROR in `src/metadata.py` (candidate: https://ror.org/00g07sz63). 3. The raw archive already has a DOI (10.5281/zenodo.23416916). Correct that Zenodo record's licence to CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see report/zenodo_record_corrections.md), and optionally deposit `data/cleaned/` as its own record to replace the placeholder `10.5281/zenodo.TO-BE-MINTED`. 4. Personalise the reflection drafts in `report/reflection_drafts/` (each student submits their own).

title: README: Re-running the live F-UJI assessment (optional)
text: The stored responses in `outputs/component_a_fair/fuji/` are the evidence used in the report. To repeat the evaluation, start a local F-UJI server (Python 3.13, https://github.com/pangaea-data-publisher/fuji) and run `python -m src.run_fuji_assessment`.
